svg.title: TOMBO: compound-eye inspiration, evidence-driven checking
svg.desc: A stylized dragonfly and magnified faceted eye illustrate multiple viewpoints as a metaphor. The actual implementation takes a task and evidence, obtains proposals from a generation adapter, validates evidence-linked state and selects probes, and reports decisions and unresolved gaps. The caller executes authorized probes and returns observations. Optional Hidden-Side geometry supplies unverified candidates only; it cannot create evidence or resolve claims.
svg.text: A compound-eye metaphor for checking a draft, its assumptions, and what remains unknown.
